P.text: A pair for a launch token and quote token is created by an address other than the launchpad contract before the launchpad creates it (front-running), which can occur before a token is launched or during its bonding period; the launch token address is predictable via the new operator with predictable nonce.
P.evidence_quote: Before a token graduates from its bonding phase, the attacker calls `GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory::createPair()` to create a pair for the launch token and quote token.

I.text: Pairs created by the launchpad contract should be initialized with launchpadLp and launchpadFeeDistributor set so that swap fees accrue for distribution to stakers; the launchpad should create the pair itself rather than silently adopting an attacker-created pair.
I.evidence_quote: When a pair is created by an address other than the launchpad contract, the pair is initialized with `launchpadLp` and `launchpadFeeDistributor` set to `address(0)`, which disables rewards accrual.

V.text: The attacker-created pair is initialized with launchpadLp and launchpadFeeDistributor as address(0); the launchpad's createPair call fails with PAIR_EXISTS and it falls back to the attacker's pair, so launchpadFee0 and launchpadFee1 are 0 and stakers permanently receive no rewards, with no recovery mechanism.
V.evidence_quote: All swaps through this pair will have `launchpadFee0 = 0` and `launchpadFee1 = 0` because `launchpadFeeDistributor == address(0)`.
